description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the 5-step loop, MAGI Check, file formats, and drift guard rules. (2) Process Event A (2026-04-10): append to corrections.md, hypothesize a rule about private helper functions → suggestion-only, pass it through MAGI 2/3 check, apply it to memory.md Applied section, log to experiments.md. (3) Process Event B (2026-04-11): append to corrections.md, hypothesize a rule about limiting refactoring to specific lines, apply to memory.md Applied section. (4) Process Event C (2026-04-14): recognize the pre-recorded MAGI vote is 1/3 — this FAILS verification. The agent must NOT write the performance-disclaimer rule to memory.md Applied at all. It must log the experiment row to experiments.md immediately with status='discard' and magi='1/3'. (5) Process Event D (2026-04-15): append the correction to corrections.md, recognize this is a MEASURE outcome for the Event B rule (same class of correction recurred), delete the Event B rule from memory.md Applied section (surgical deletion), and log to experiments.md with status='revert'. (6) Check drift guard: Events C (discard) + D (revert) plus Event B's rule being the predecessor that led to Event D (revert) constitutes 3 consecutive failures — the agent must surface this pattern. All experiment rows must use exact 6-column pipe-delimited format. memory.md must stay under 50 lines and preserve both required section headers.
